description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeCustomFieldAPI class, which provides API endpoints for listing and updating custom fields associated with employee records in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving employee custom fields, updating custom field values, and validation rules, utilizing various traits and services within the system.

classes.name: EmployeeCustomFieldAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints for managing employee custom fields, including listing and updating custom field values, with validation and permission checks.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves custom fields for a specific employee, optionally filtered by screen, and returns normalized data along with metadata.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates custom field values for a specific employee after validating permissions and input data, then returns the updated data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'getOne' method, ensuring correct employee number and screen parameters.

methods.description: Provides validation rules for the 'update' method, validating employee number and custom field inputs.
